_units: Combined arms A3 (cg_brief queue item 2.2; docs/combined_arms.md 2.5, 2.7, 9.1): what each armoured model's crew fights with, merged into the model's spec by VehicleSpecs (per-topic file, keyed by model id). Every number is Proposed. guns: the new mounted weapons (VehicleSpecs.gun falls back to these): kind cannon (one round at a time from a rack, a loader's cycle), autocannon (belt from a ready box per feed), atgm (missiles from a launcher), mg (Ballistics through the vehicle's cargo feed, as data/vehicles.json's guns). models.<id>.turret: VehicleTurret's numbers (vehicle frame, m; data/vehicles.json's turret key). weapons: the mounts, each {id, gun, seat (the seat that fires it), turret (main: on the main gun, which elevates; ring: on the turret ring, aimed with the gun's line; cupola/pintle: turns with the turret, aimed by its man), muzzle (at rest), modules (any of them destroyed: out), sights (all of them destroyed: out), legacy (the vehicle's own 'gun': fired through Vehicle.server_fire_gun, its feed in the cargo)}. A cannon adds racks (pulled from by the loader, in order), stowage (restocks the first rack), loader_seat, commander_seat, battlecarry (the round loaded at the start). An autocannon adds ready (the ready-box rack), stowage. An atgm adds stowage and ready (missiles on the launcher). racks: {module id of an ammo_rack: {shell id: rounds}}, the default load-out; the module's own 'rounds' (data/vehicle_modules.json) is the total the racks keep. switch_s: timed seat moves (2.5.3): turret (within the turret), driver (turret to the driver's station or back; front_deg: the turret within this of the front), troop (troop compartment to a crew seat).
